title: Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.06718v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complet

translated_title: 通过中心流分析研究稳定性边缘处的对称性破缺
translated_abstract: 神经网络中的连续对称性会导致在梯度流下保持不变的守恒量，例如线性和ReLU网络中的层平衡性。有限步梯度下降并不一定保持这些守恒律，特别是在稳定性边缘处，此时迭代点围绕一条更平滑的轨迹振荡，而这条轨迹可以用中心流动力学（Cohen et al., 2025）来描述。我们研究了在这一区域的中心流描述下，梯度流守恒律如何演化。我们证明，曲率修正会引入一个由沿临界参数方向的振荡协方差所决定的有限维漂移。因此，我们通过分析标量两层模型、两层矩阵分解以及两层ReLU网络，迈出了在稳定性边缘处分析哪些守恒律得以保持、哪些被打破的第一步，其中已知的守恒律被证明是……
tldr: 本文借助中心流分析首次系统研究了神经网络在稳定性边缘处的对称性破缺现象，证明曲率修正会引入由临界参数方向上振荡协方差决定的有限维漂移，从而打破了梯度流下的连续对称性守恒律（如层平衡性），并在标量两层模型、两层矩阵分解和两层ReLU网络中刻画了哪些守恒律得以保持、哪些被破坏。
en_tdlr: Using central flow analysis, this paper takes the first steps toward identifying which gradient-flow conservation laws from neural network symmetries are preserved or broken at the edge of stability, showing that curvature corrections induce a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions.
